evidence.observation: H701 heater temperature reads 343.228 °C, markedly higher than H702 at 75.837 °C and the reboiler at 65.736 °C.

T701 has risen to 345.451 °C while T702 is 75.965 °C and T703 is 65.821 °C; the persistent isolated high reading warrants verification, but does not distinguish actual overheating from a measurement fault.

Pressure is 398.870 mbar, differential pressures are 0.109 and 2.016 mbar, column temperatures T705/T712 are 58.564/58.322 °C, reflux is 0.416 and cooling-water flow is 3.902; these show no corresponding sustained process excursion.

args.missing_evidence: H701 operating setpoint and permissible heater temperature, heater power/status, and an independent H701 temperature measurement are needed to distinguish expected heater behavior, overheating, and sensor error. No composition measurement or target composition is provided.
